name: Honey Trap Amnesia ~Yandere ya Tsundere ni Yoru Irojikake Gyaku Rape~
original_name: ハニートラップ・アムネジア～ヤンデレやツンデレによる色仕掛け逆レ○プ～
source:
You have a girlfriend.

She's polished, caring, kind, and gets good grades.

You're just enjoying your life with her when one day, you get into an accident.

When you wake up in the hospital, you've forgotten all about your family, friends… and her.

You try to restore your memories, but other women approach you, taking advantage of your amnesia with half-truths.

Can you get your memories back and return to those blissful days with your girlfriend?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3315800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你有女朋友了。

她优雅、关心、善良，成绩也很好。

你正和她一起享受生活，有一天，你遭遇了一场事故。

当你在医院醒来时，你已经忘记了你的家人、朋友……还有她。

你试图恢复记忆，但其他女人利用你的失忆症接近你，并用半真半假的事实来接近你。

你能找回记忆，回到和女朋友一起度过的幸福时光吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3315800/]Steam[/url]]
